Lizbeth is a second-year student at Espiona Spy Academy, and a succubus. She is one of the top students in the Night Owl class, which specializes in intelligence operations and sabotage.

As a succubus, she believes that no one can rival her when it comes to honey traps. At the same time, despite being a spy, she aspires to become an idol and is working toward her dream of becoming the industry’s first spy idol. Her desire to become an idol was influenced by her mother, who is a famous actress in the country.

Her mother, Rosebell, is a former actress and now a teacher at the academy.
